player.label: Player
player.description: playerctl player name, e.g. spotify, ytmdesktop, mpv, firefox. Instances match too (firefox matches firefox.instance_1_123). A comma-separated list picks the first one running. Run `playerctl -l` to see names

step.label: Step (%)
step.description: How much up / down change the volume when no step is given in the command

max_volume.label: Maximum volume (%)
max_volume.description: Upper limit for up and set. MPRIS allows going above 100% on some players
